ar01.text: اسمي يوسف. <short pause> مهندس من القاهرة، عندي ستة وعشرين سنة… <short pause> والنهارده أول يوم ليّا في لندن.
ar01.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Opening of the story, inviting.

ar02.text: جاي أدرس إنجليزي وأشتغل هنا. <short pause> وكنت فاكر إن الإنجليزي بتاعي كويس… <short pause> لحد ما قابلت ميا.
ar02.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Ends with a small knowing laugh in the voice.

ar03.text: طول الطريق من المطار وأنا بحضّر أول جملة هقولها. <short pause> هقولها بثقة… وبابتسامة.
ar03.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Confident, a bit proud.

ar04.text: ولقيت المدرسة. <short pause> باب أزرق، ويافطة كبيرة… <short pause> والباب اتفتح.
ar04.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Building suspense at the end.

ar05.text: سوري؟! <short pause> هي ما سمعتنيش؟ ولا أنا قلت حاجة غلط؟ <short pause> ما أنا قلت اسمي أهو!
ar05.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Panicked and embarrassed, faster, comic.

ar06.text: المرة دي فهمتني على طول. <short pause> الفرق كان كلمة واحدة صغيرة… هحكيلكم عليها في الآخر.
ar06.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Relieved, then teasing.

ar07.text: اليوم عدّى بسرعة. <short pause> كلاس، وناس جديدة، وكلام كتير ما فهمتش نصه.
ar07.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Light, a bit tired, amused.

ar08.text: تمانية الصبح؟! <short pause> هو أنا جاي أدرس… ولا جاي الجيش؟
ar08.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Shocked, comic.

ar09.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Upbeat, like a friendly teacher.

ar10.text: أول حاجة، غلطتي. <short pause> أنا قلت: آي يوسف. <short pause> في العربي بنقول أنا يوسف من غير أي فعل… <short pause> لكن في الإنجليزي لازم يبقى فيه: آم.
ar10.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Clear and explanatory, friendly teacher.

ar11.text: وغالبًا بنختصرها لـ: آيم، <short pause> وبتتقال بسرعة كأنها كلمة واحدة.
ar11.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Clear and explanatory.

ar12.text: ولو عايز تسأل حد عن اسمه، <short pause> والرد:
ar12.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Clear and explanatory.

ar13.text: ولما حد يقولك: نايس تو ميت يو، <short pause> ما تقولش: مي تو. <short pause> قول:
ar13.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Clear, a little playful.

ar14.text: ولو ما سمعتش كويس، قول ببساطة:
ar14.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Clear and explanatory.

ar15.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Light.

ar16.text: دورك! <short pause> ميا بتسألك… رد عليها بصوت عالي.
ar16.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Energetic, encouraging.

ar17.text: قلتها بـ آيم؟ <short pause> برافو عليك! <short pause> واكتبها في الكومنتات.
ar17.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Proud and warm.

ar18.text: الحلقة الجاية: <short pause> صحيت متأخر، وأول ما شفت ميا سألتني: هاو آر يو؟… <short pause> وأنا رديت رد عمري ما هنساه.
ar18.style: Youssef, a friendly 26-year-old Egyptian man from Cairo, narrating his own travel diary in natural Egyptian Arabic (Cairo dialect). Warm, self-amused, intimate like telling a friend, medium pace. Teaser, mysterious and funny.

ar19.text: وعشان الجمل دي تثبت في دماغك… <short pause> ادخل على الموقع وحل تمارين الحلقة. <short pause> خمس دقايق بس. <short pause> اللينك في الوصف.
